result.topic_en: Draft of the setup of Riemann's method for the linear hyperbolic equation $w_{pq}-w_p+w_q=0$ with data on a curve s: multiply by an undetermined function v and integrate by parts over a region of the pq-plane, giving an area integral of the adjoint expression plus a boundary integral.

methods.what: Linear second-order hyperbolic PDE in characteristic coordinates p, q
methods.quote: $\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial p\partial q} - \frac{\partial w}{\partial p} + \frac{\partial w}{\partial q} = 0$

methods.what: Cauchy-type initial data: first derivatives of w given on a curve s in the pq-plane, so w is known up to an additive constant
methods.quote:
In dieser Curve s seien {+die Werthe+} $\frac{\partial w}{\partial p}$ und $\frac{\partial w}{\partial q}$ gegeben und folglich w bis auf eine willkürlich zu
wählende Constante [-gegeben-]

methods.what: Analogy with solving a linear system by multiplying by suitable factors and adding (idea of the adjoint method)
methods.quote:
ganz ähnliches Verfahren [-anwenden-] {+wie man zur+} Auflösung eines Systems von linearen
Gleichungen diese mit geeigneten Factoren multiplicirt und addirt

methods.what: Multiply the PDE by an arbitrary function v and integrate over a region
methods.quote: $\int v\left(\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial p\partial q} - \frac{\partial w}{\partial p} + \frac{\partial w}{\partial q}\right)\partial p\,\partial q$

methods.what: Integration by parts (Green's formula) giving the area integral of the adjoint operator applied to v plus a boundary integral
methods.quote: $\int w\left(\frac{\partial^2 v}{\partial p\partial q} + \frac{\partial v}{\partial p} - \frac{\partial v}{\partial q}\right)\partial p\,\partial q + \int\left(\left(v\frac{\partial w}{\partial q} + w\right)dp + v\frac{\partial w}{\partial p}\,dq\right)$
